    About Bharat Business Desk

    We are a loan and investment advisory company for Indian businesses and projects. We guide businesses on loans and projects on investments across sectors, and take care of the advice and paperwork, so you can focus on running your business and projects.

    What loans do you help with?

    Secured loans, unsecured loans, structured finance, equity finance and more.

    Do you help with documents?

    Yes. We advise on the documents needed for your loan and how to prepare them.

    Do you advise us during the loan process?

    Yes. We advise you through your loan process. Approval, timelines and final decisions rest with the bank and are subject to its terms and conditions and policies.
